proposed_widenings.name: modify_roll_substitute
proposed_widenings.justification: Reliable Talent floors the d20 result at 10 — any roll of 9 or lower is treated as 10. This is not additive (modify_roll_numeric) nor a re-roll, but a threshold substitution: if roll < threshold, replace with floor_value. The v4 taxonomy lists modify_roll_substitute in section 9 Effect Atoms, but it is absent from types.ts.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you can treat a d20 roll of 9 or lower as a 10

proposed_widenings.name: SkillFilter.proficient
proposed_widenings.justification: Reliable Talent applies to any ability check using a skill or tool proficiency the character holds — not a fixed named list of skills. The current SkillFilter only supports { kind: 'fixed', skills: [...] } and { kind: 'choice', options: [...] }, neither of which can express 'all skills/tools where the character has proficiency'. A new kind such as 'proficient' would be needed to scope the rider to the character's actual proficiency set at runtime.
proposed_widenings.evidence: ability check that uses one of your skill or tool proficiencies

notes: The outer structure (class_feature + passive family) fits cleanly. Both gaps are surface-level: modify_roll_substitute is already named in the v4 taxonomy (section 9) but not implemented in types.ts; the proficiency-scoped filter is a new variant of SkillFilter. No new top-level family or v4 atom invention is needed — this is a surface catch-up, not a taxonomy extension.
